rules.accepted_credit_types: Licensees select programs directly related to scope of practice (ARM 24.219.435(6)); max 10 hours for first-time preparation of a new course/workshop/seminar or a first-time published/presented paper. The board does not list approved providers.
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE requirements apply only after the licensee's first renewal.
rules.carryover: Hours above 20 may be carried forward into the next year, max 20 hours.
rules.audit_note: Department may randomly audit up to 50% of renewed licensees; keep documentation 3 years (name, title/content, presenter/sponsor, dates, hours).

topics.who: All licensees: suicide risk assessment and safety planning, every odd year

rules.legal_basis: ARM 24.219.435 (as amended by MAR Notice No. 2026-512, effective 8/22/2026)
rules.notes: Annual renewal, window November 1 - December 31. Holders of more than one license need 20 hours per license. LAC licenses (same board) renew May 1 - June 30 under the same CE rule.
